intro:
Madrid — 13 November 1936

Commander, the Army of Africa has reached Madrid's western and southern approaches. The direct road into the capital runs through the Casa de Campo and across the Manzanares. If the attackers establish themselves beyond the river, the defence becomes a fight from building to building.

Hold the bridges and the university district, and recover Puente de los Franceses. Republican mixed brigades, militia and International Brigade volunteers are sharing the defence. Keep a reserve inside the city to seal any crossing the enemy forces. Madrid must remain the centre of our resistance. No pasaran.

briliant.text:
El ejercito de Africa ha sido frenado en seco!, es el primer exito importante de nuestras valerosas tropas. Gran trabajo, general. Madrid ha sido defendido con exito y ahora se convertira en el ejemplo a seguir por todos los pueblos de este pais, que estan tratando de resistir a la amenaza fascista.

The African Army has been stopped! This is the first important successful action of our soldiers. Great work, Madrid has been successfully defended, and now it will be a resistance symbol for the people of this country fighting against the Fascist menace!

intro:
Jarama Valley — 16 February 1937

The direct assault on Madrid has failed, and the Nationalists are trying to cut the road linking the capital with Valencia. The Jarama valley is now the hinge of that attempt to isolate the city.

Hold the river positions and Morata de Tajuna, then counterattack towards Perales and Pinto. Cerro de los Angeles must remain secure while the line is restored. Our divisions and International Brigade units have Soviet-supplied armour, but experienced enemy infantry stands between them and the road we need to keep open.

briliant.text:
Felicidades!, ha demostrado usted ser un buen mando para el Ejercito Popular. La ofensiva rebelde en el valle del Jarama se ha detenido por el momento y hemos conseguido demostrarles a los rebeldes que nuestras fuerzas deben ser tenidas en cuenta.

Congratulations! You have showed the proper skills to be a good commander for the People's Army. The Rebel offensive has been stopped for the moment, and the fascists have already seen the valor of our troops.

intro:
Guadalajara — 8 March 1937

Italian troops of the Corpo Truppe Volontarie are advancing on the Guadalajara front with Nationalist support. Their purpose is to approach Madrid from the north-east and complete the encirclement that the Jarama offensive failed to achieve.

Stop the columns on the Brihuega-Torija approaches, hold Guadalajara and counterattack towards Algora. The roads concentrate the Italian advance. Our tanks and aircraft can strike there once the infantry has held the leading formations and drawn them away from their reserves.

briliant.text:
Magnifico!, los italianos huyen despaboridos mientras los rebeldes tratan de mantener las lineas de frente. Esta derrota despeja por completo el peligro sobre Madrid, al menos por el momento, y nos posibilitara empezar a pensar en acciones ofensivas en semanas posteriores.

Great! The Italians are running to the hills instead of trying to hold their front lines. This victory will stop the rebel menace at Madrid, at least for the moment, and allow us to think about further operations in the coming weeks.

Viva la republica!

intro:
Brunete — 6 July 1937

Commander, the Republic is taking the offensive west of Madrid. A breakthrough here threatens the Nationalist salient near the capital and may force the enemy to divert troops from the hard-pressed northern front.

V and XVIII Corps will move from the north on Brunete and Villafranca del Castillo, with support from the Madrid direction. Take the towns and the strongpoints through Quijorna and Villaviciosa de Odon. Keep Valdemorillo secure behind the attack; we need the roads open before the enemy's reserves arrive.

briliant.text:
Se han alcanzado todos los objetivos de la operacion, sin embargo debido a la superioridad aerea enemiga y a la calidad de sus tropas, debemos retirar nuestras unidades de Brunete a posiciones ligeramente mas al Norte.
Buen trabajo.

All the goals have been achieved. However, due to the enemy air superiority and the quality of their troops, we must retreat our troops from Brunete to Northern positions.

Good Work. I wish El Ejercito Popular had more commanders of your quality and initiative.

intro:
Aragon offensive — 24 August 1937

Brunete did not produce the breakthrough headquarters wanted. The northern front remains under pressure, and a new offensive in Aragon is intended to draw Nationalist reserves away from it.

Attack through Quinto, Fuentes de Ebro, Mediana and Belchite, with another thrust towards Zuera. Zaragoza is the wider aim, but the fortified towns bar the roads to it. Keep Lecera and Puebla de Hijar secure while the columns break through; a stalled offensive will draw no troops away from the north.

briliant.text:
El plan principal ha fracasado... el contraataque enemigo frustro nuestro ataque sobre Zaragoza, sin embargo los servicios de propaganda explotaran esta victoria secundaria en Belchite de la mejor manera posible.

The main plan hasn't been accomplished, the rebel counterattack defeated our attack on Zaragoza. However, our propaganda services will try to exploit this minor victory at Belchite...

However, commandante, you must understand that tactical victories do not balance strategic failures.

intro:
Teruel — 15 December 1937

The northern Republican zone has fallen. Headquarters now seeks to regain the initiative by attacking the Nationalist salient at Teruel, forcing the enemy to answer our offensive instead of choosing the next battlefield himself.

Surround Teruel and take the town from Rey d'Harcourt's garrison. Keep Sarrion and the outer approaches secure against the relief forces. The winter roads make ammunition and food difficult to bring forward; the troops entering the city must not be cut off from their supplies.

briliant.text:
La amenaza sobre Levante se ha disipado tras la captura de Teruel y la derrota del potente contraataque que lanzo el enemigo!. La batalla ha sido terrible, pero la victoria nos ha favorecido.

The rebel offensive in and around Levante has been stopped after our victory in Teruel!. Excellent work!

The battle has been horrible... and more horrible has been the retreat. After the fall of Teruel, the rebels have overrun our troops. Maybe this strike against El Ejercito Popular has sealed our fate. In spite of your failure here, the high command, and the Republic, still need your services. For all our sakes, you must succeed next time.

intro:
Ebro offensive — 25 July 1938

The Nationalists have reached the Mediterranean and divided Republican territory. The Army of the Ebro is preparing a surprise crossing to recover the initiative and draw pressure away from the remaining Republican fronts.

Cross the Ebro, widen the bridgeheads and advance on Gandesa. Seize the intervening towns and hill positions while keeping the crossings covered. Surprise will help the first troops across, but the army following them needs bridges that survive the enemy's aircraft and counterattacks.

briliant.text:
Fantastico!, los rebeldes se baten en retirada, nuestro ataque por sorpresa cruzando el Ebro ha sido todo un exito gracias a su pericia. Ahora todo el sector de Levante que los fascistas habian alcanzado esta comprometido y deberan retirarse de ahi si no quieren verse rodeados. Esta victoria elevara la moral de toda la zona leal al gobierno.

Wonderful! The rebels are in disarray and retreating all their units in the sector. Our surprise attack across the Ebro has been totally accomplished thanks to your skills, and brave soldiers. Now, all of the Levante sector under rebel control is in chaos and will soon be recaptured by El Ejercito Popular. This victory will increase the morale of all the citizens of free Spain!

Congratulations, General.

victory.text:
Hemos conseguido alcanzar una victoria estrategica, pero el enemigo ha sabido encajar el golpe y la ofensiva no va a tener los efectos planeados... ahora se espera un fuerte contraataque enemigo. Prepare las trincheras.

We have achieved a minor victory, however the enemy has stopped our advance and in several other sectors. The planned offensive won't reach all the main goals, and many enemy formations are still operational. Intelligence has warned of a counterattack in your sector soon. I advise you to order your troops to dig in.

Commandante, you must hold your lines if the Republic is to survive.

intro:
Ebro counteroffensive — 3 September 1938

Our advance has been stopped short of Gandesa, and Nationalist counterattacks are wearing down the bridgehead. German and Italian aircraft strike the roads and crossings. Headquarters is ordering a withdrawal before the army is trapped against the river.

Cover the retreat towards the eastern bank and secure the positions at Vinebre and Masroig. Keep the crossing approaches in our hands while the columns pull back. An early rush to safety would abandon the rearguard and turn an organised withdrawal into a rout.

Campaign note: finish within the Victory or Tactical Victory deadline to continue to the Segre. A Brilliant Victory ends this branch in defeat.

briliant.text:
Que...?? a donde va con esas tropas?, que clase de retirada ha planeado?, su cobardia muestra que no es apto para el Ejercito Popular.

What!?? Where are you going with those troops!!?? What kind of retreat are you making??? Your cowardice shows you are not the general which the People's Army needs! You are dismissed, as an officer, but not from the army, private!

Remember, "Victoria o muerte," but with this performance, death seems more likely.

victory.text:
Hemos conseguido hacer una retirada medianamente ordenada, sin embargo algunas unidades han quedado atras y han sido capturadas por el enemigo.

The retreat was successful, Senor General, although a few more of our units have been captured by the enemy.

tactical.text:
Afortunadamente hemos conseguido hacer una retirada ordenada y la mayor parte del Ejercito Popular ha cruzado en direccion contraria el rio Ebro.

Fortunately, you have managed to make a careful retreat to the other bank of the river, and most of the People's Army is now safe for the moment. Unfortunately, careful retreats and saving what is left of our army will not defeat the Falangists.

lose.text:
Ah!, un general republicano!, el alto mando del generalisimo estara encantado de saber que ademas de haber destruido todo su sucio ''ejercito del Ebro'' hemos capturado a un general rojo. Trataremos de sacar partido con su captura y si no nos sirve le fusilaremos por traicion a la patria!.

Nationalist officer - "Aha!, a Republican General! The high command of the Generalisimo will be pleased to know that your nasty ''Army of the Ebro'' has been destroyed, and also that we have captured a red general! [evil laughter]. You will be executed soon for your betrayal of Spain!

"Despite you, Spain shall be 'un grande libre.'"

intro:
Segre River — 6 November 1938

The Ebro battle has exhausted the army, and Catalonia is increasingly exposed. Headquarters is ordering a local offensive south of Lerida to improve the river line and threaten the enemy's communications.

Cross the Segre through Seros and Aytona and drive towards the enemy command position at Fraga. Protect Torres de Segre and the crossings behind the attack. The army needs a firmer river line and a threat to the Nationalist communications that will draw pressure away from our own.

briliant.text:
Esta victoria nos permitira respirar un poco mas, pero le informo de que algunos mandos se han pasado al enemigo y otros han huido a traves de la frontera francesa. Personalmente le sugiero que hagamos lo mismo y nos salvemos antes de que sea tarde, la ofensiva rebelde sobre Catalunya continua imparable...

Nota historica--- Historicamente la guerra termino en Abril de 1939, despues de la caida de Catalunya y la redicion de Madrid a las tropas rebeldes.

This victory will allow us to take a breath, but I must warn you that many army officers have joined the enemy! Others have abandoned the fight and crossed the Spanish - French border to escape. Personally, I advise you to cross the border, too, and save yourself. I think the rebel offensive is unbeatable now.

Historical note--- The war finally ended in April, 1939 with the rebel victory after the fall of Catalunya and the surrender of Madrid to rebels. The prelude to WWII was over, and September 1, 1939 was quickly approaching.

intro:
Zaragoza — 12 February 1939

Success at the Ebro and Segre has kept the Republic on the offensive. The French border has reopened and Soviet weapons have reached the army. Zaragoza is again within reach.

Advance through Osera, Fuentes de Ebro and Mediana and take Zaragoza. Italian CTV formations and troops of the Nationalist Thirteenth Division stand in the way; guerrillas behind their lines will assist the attack. Keep our southern bases secure while the army fights for this communications centre.

intro:
Ceuta and Tetuan — 5 August 1939

The Republic has won on the mainland, but Nationalist forces have withdrawn into the Spanish protectorate in Morocco. Ceuta and Tetuan are the last bases from which they can continue the war.

Land at Ceuta and take the port, then advance towards Tetuan. The fleet from Cartagena will support the landings, and detachments are already ashore. Legion troops and formations withdrawn from Spain defend the approaches. Open the port quickly so our artillery and reserves can follow the first wave.

briliant.text:
LA GUERRA HA TERMINADO!, en multitud de puntos del pais se celebra la victoria por todo lo alto!. De ahora en adelante se abre una nueva etapa en la que nuestra patria debe modernizarse y afrontar nuevos desafios. Usted formara parte en adelante de la historia de Espana para siempre.

The WAR IS OVER! All the people are in the streets celebrating the victory of the Republic's victory over the fascist rebels! From now, and in the future, a new political system will try to modernize Spain without any kind of capitalist or traditionalist intervention. Excellent work general, obviously you are one of the new heroes of the Spanish Republic, and your name will be written for ever in the ancient Spanish history.

LA GUERRA HA TERMINADO!, en multitud de puntos del pais se celebra la victoria por todo lo alto!. De ahora en adelante se abre una nueva etapa en la que nuestra patria debe modernizarse y afrontar nuevos desafios. Usted formara parte en adelante de la historia de Espana para siempre.

The WAR IS OVER! All the people are in the streets celebrating the victory of the Republic's victory over the fascist rebels! From now, and in the future, a new political system will try to modernize Spain without any kind of capitalist or traditionalist intervention. Excellent work general, obviously you are one of the new heroes of the Spanish Republic, and your name will be written for ever in the ancient Spanish history.
